sources: RCSB PDB 1EMA, supplied to the viewer by the plugin's bundled example
observations: The mounted viewer identified 1EMA as an X-ray structure at 1.9 angstrom resolution.
The displayed model contained 225 protein residues, 1866 atoms, and CRO at chain A author residue 66.
A deterministic calculation from the retained 1EMA PDB returned 18 polymer residues within 4.0 angstrom of CRO using closest heavy-atom Euclidean distance.
The retained 1EMA PDB digest exactly matches the source digest recorded in the viewer render sidecar.
A 1600 by 1200 PNG and render provenance file were generated and visually inspected; no CRO text label is visible.
Rosalind Workbench returned its ready task chooser for the recorded case-specific invocation.
interpretation: The chromophore occupies the protected interior of the GFP beta barrel.
limitations: The 4 angstrom contact display is a coordinate-distance analysis, not an energetic interaction model.
CRO is polymer-linked; the shortest contact records include covalent geometry.
The current render keeps all source-visible small components, including solvent markers.
No successful standalone viewer receipts are retained for open_from_chat, analyze, apply_scene, or validate_render.
rosalind_open did not submit 1EMA, render the figure, or execute a Rosalind scientific job.
